name: FairValid Customer API
description: Verify email addresses, read asynchronous verification results, and find verified work emails with FairMatch through a scoped customer REST API.
notes: A FairValid account includes 300 shared free credits each month for email verification and FairMatch. Valid or invalid verification results use one credit; each newly delivered verified FairMatch contact uses four. Unknown and unresolved catch-all checks have no net charge. Scoped API-key authentication is required; optional paid credits are available. The hosted service is proprietary.
